decisions.evidence: Putting all six neighbors together, the picture is consistent with option (A). The three positive neighbors all end up weakening the binding case because the query lacks some favorable heteroaromatic or thiomorpholine-related features and shows higher partial-charge extrema and, in several comparisons, lower QED or less favorable structural balance. The three negative neighbors reinforce the same conclusion: despite occasional favorable shifts such as higher sp3 character or higher acidic pKa, the query’s reduced aromaticity, lower QED, and stronger charge-related features do not outweigh the non-binder analogs. The combined neighborhood evidence therefore supports does not bind SARS-CoV-2 3CL protease.
